name: Voices of the District
description: Pavel wants a report on public morale. Speak with seven residents; their stories reveal that official assurances do not match daily life.

stages.description: Ask Viktor Petrov about the town.
Ask Zofia Nowak about the town.
Ask Elena Jovanovic about the town.
Ask Dusan Markovic about the town.
Ask Nadia Morozova about the town.
Ask Milena Vukovic about the town.
Ask Irina Kovalenko about the town.
Report the townspeople’s opinions to Pavel Sokolov. Pavel asks whether anyone questioned the quarantine rules.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Each resident describes the quarantine through personal experience and bias; Pavel uses the interviews to gauge public loyalty.
implementationNotes: Maintain all seven existing dialogue choice IDs.
On completion set story flag prologue_investigations_unlocked and offer three independent branch openings.
